source.doc: 欧盟委员会消费者安全科学委员会（SCCS）化妆品成分安全性意见（Opinions）与科学建议（Scientific Advice）
source.collection: data/tools/collect_sccs.py 抓取 SCCS 意见列表页（2009-2013 / 2013-2016 / 2016-2021 / 2022+ 四段）关键词匹配目标成分，下载官方 PDF 存 data/raw/sccs/pdf/，自动抽取 OPINION/CONCLUSION 区含 safe/% 候选句存 data/raw/sccs/extraction.json（原始缓存 data/raw/sccs/listing_*.html、hits.json、pdfs.json）。
source.verification: 2026-08-10 对 extraction.json 候选句逐条人工核订：每个成分取最新正式意见的结论句原文进 excerpt；候选句缺失的（sccs_o_103 氧化锌、sccs_o_195 苯氧乙醇、sccs_o_074 HICC、sccs_o_168 MBBT、sccs_o_093 甲苯-2,5-二胺、sccs_o_094 对苯二胺、sccs_o_293 二苯酮-1、sccs_o_299 DHHB）直接回读 PDF 结论章节核对；数值与适用范围均照原文，不做推断。PPD 命中中仅 sccs_o_094 为对苯二胺本体意见，其余为 A 系/B 系染发剂衍生物意见，不采用。2026-08-10 复审（独立审查 M2）：sccs_limit 口径定为「该意见内最严上限」，ALPHA-ARBUTIN/OCTOCRYLENE/BENZOPHENONE-3/TITANIUM DIOXIDE/TRICLOSAN/SALICYLIC ACID/RETINOL/RETINYL ACETATE/RETINYL PALMITATE/BHT/DIHYDROXYACETONE 共 11 条数值相应改小，分场景上限保留在 scope。
source.boundary_note: SCCS 是欧盟委员会官方科学委员会，意见是监管决策的科学依据，证据类型记 regulation（对齐 NMPA 法规层处理惯例），但不是法规文本本身；结论多区分产品类型与暴露情景，sccs_limit 统一回填该意见内最严上限（多场景结论取最严值），分场景结论完整保留在 scope/note/excerpt；scientific advice 不是正式意见，conclusion_kind=advice 单独标注；「不安全」结论 sccs_limit 留 null。

entries.title: Safety of alpha-arbutin and beta-arbutin in cosmetic products
entries.scope: 面霜最高 2%；身体乳最高 0.5%（可合并使用）
entries.excerpt: The SCCS is of the opinion that alpha-arbutin used in face creams up to a maximum concentration of 2% and in body lotions up to a concentration of 0.5% is safe, also when used together.
entries.note: SCCS 安全评估上限（面霜 2%/身体乳 0.5%），非功效起效浓度；取代旧意见 SCCS/1552/15。sccs_limit 取该意见内最严上限，分场景上限见适用范围。
entries.assertion: 安全评估：SCCS 认为 α-熊果苷用于面霜最高 2%、身体乳最高 0.5% 安全（SCCS/1642/22）

entries.title: Safety of alpha-arbutin and beta-arbutin in cosmetic products
entries.scope: β-熊果苷用于面霜最高 7%
entries.excerpt: The SCCS is of the opinion that beta-arbutin used in face creams up to a maximum concentration of 7% is safe.
entries.note: 该条针对 β-熊果苷；SCCS 安全评估上限（面霜 7%），非功效起效浓度。
entries.assertion: 安全评估：SCCS 认为 β-熊果苷用于面霜最高 7% 安全（SCCS/1642/22）

entries.title: Kojic acid
entries.scope: 用作美白剂（skin lightening agent）最高 1%
entries.excerpt: On the basis of the safety assessment, and considering the concerns related to potential endocrine disrupting properties of Kojic acid, the SCCS is of the opinion that Kojic acid is safe when used as a skin lightening agent in cosmetic products at concentrations of up to 1%.
entries.note: SCCS 安全评估上限（美白用途 1%），非功效起效浓度；评估考虑了潜在内分泌干扰疑虑。
entries.assertion: 安全评估：SCCS 认为曲酸用作美白剂最高 1% 安全（SCCS/1637/21）

entries.title: Homosalate
entries.scope: 成品中最高 0.5%（10% 不安全）
entries.excerpt: In the SCCS's opinion, the use of homosalate as a UV filter in cosmetic products is safe for the consumer up to a maximum concentration of 0.5% homosalate in the final product.
entries.note: SCCS/1622/20 结论：10% 不安全，最高 0.5% 安全；后续科学建议 SCCS/1638/21 认为面部产品（面霜与泵式喷雾）最高 7.34% 安全。sccs_limit 取正式意见 0.5%。SCCS 安全评估上限，非功效起效浓度。
entries.assertion: 安全评估：SCCS 认为胡莫柳酯最高 0.5% 安全（10% 不安全；SCCS/1622/20）

entries.title: Octocrylene
entries.scope: 单独或组合使用最高 10%；防晒抛射剂喷雾组合使用最高 9%
entries.excerpt: On the basis of safety assessment, and considering the concerns related to potential endocrine disrupting properties of Octocrylene, the SCCS is of the opinion that Octocrylene is safe as a UV-filter at concentrations up to 10% in cosmetic products when used individually.
entries.note: 10% 单独使用安全；防晒抛射剂喷雾与其他产品组合使用时不超过 9%。SCCS 安全评估上限，非功效起效浓度。sccs_limit 取该意见内最严上限，分场景上限见适用范围。
entries.assertion: 安全评估：SCCS 认为奥克立林最高 10% 安全（抛射剂喷雾组合使用最高 9%；SCCS/1627/21）

entries.title: Ethylhexyl Methoxycinnamate (EHMC)
entries.scope: 防晒、面部、手部与唇部产品（含喷雾）单独或组合最高 10%
entries.excerpt: Having considered the data provided, and the concerns relating to potential endocrine disrupting properties of EHMC, the SCCS is of the opinion that EHMC is safe when used as a UV filter up to a maximum concentration of 10% in sunscreen products, face, hand and lip products, including propellant and pump spray, when used separately or in combination.
entries.note: SCCS 安全评估上限（10%），非功效起效浓度；评估考虑了潜在内分泌干扰疑虑。
entries.assertion: 安全评估：SCCS 认为甲氧基肉桂酸乙基己酯最高 10% 安全（SCCS/1671/24）

entries.title: Benzophenone-3
entries.scope: 面霜、手霜、唇膏最高 6%（身体防晒乳/防晒喷雾 6% 不安全）；保护配方用途最高 0.5%
entries.excerpt: The use of BP-3 as a UV-filter up to a maximum concentration of 6% in face cream, hand cream, and lipsticks is safe for the consumer. The use of BP-3 up to 0.5% in cosmetic products to protect the cosmetic formulation is safe for the consumer.
entries.note: 身体防晒乳、防晒抛射剂/泵式喷雾中 6% 不安全；sccs_limit 6% 仅对面霜/手霜/唇膏成立。SCCS 安全评估上限，非功效起效浓度。sccs_limit 取该意见内最严上限，分场景上限见适用范围。
entries.assertion: 安全评估：SCCS 认为二苯酮-3 用于面霜/手霜/唇膏最高 6% 安全（身体防晒与喷雾不安全；SCCS/1625/20）

entries.title: Scientific Advice on Benzophenone-2 (BP-2) and Benzophenone-5 (BP-5)
entries.scope: 防晒、面部与手霜、唇膏、防晒喷雾单独或组合最高 5%
entries.excerpt: Thus, considering the toxicological data on Benzophenone-4, including the potential endocrine disrupting properties, the SCCS is of the opinion that BP-5 is safe when used as a UV filter up to a maximum concentration of 5% in sunscreen, face and hand cream, lipstick, sunscreen propellant spray and pump spray, when used separately or in combination.
entries.note: 此为科学建议（scientific advice），非正式意见；同文件结论二苯酮-2 因遗传毒性疑虑无法定论。SCCS 安全评估上限，非功效起效浓度。
entries.assertion: 安全评估：SCCS 科学建议认为二苯酮-5 最高 5% 安全（SCCS/1679/25，科学建议）

entries.title: Titanium dioxide (TiO2) used in cosmetic products that lead to exposure by inhalation
entries.scope: 皮肤涂抹类（含散粉）最高 25%；发用气雾喷雾最高 1.4%（消费者）/1.1%（美发师）
entries.excerpt: The safety assessment has shown that the use of pigmentary TiO2 in loose powder up to a maximum concentration of 25% in a typical face make-up application is safe for the general consumer. In the SCCS's opinion, the use of pigmentary TiO2 in a typical hair styling aerosol spray product is safe up to a maximum concentration of 1.4% for general consumers, and 1.1% for hairdressers.
entries.note: 25% 经皮使用安全（沿用 SCCS/1516/13 系列结论）；发用气雾喷雾 25% 不安全、最高 1.4%。SCCS 安全评估上限，非功效起效浓度。sccs_limit 取该意见内最严上限，分场景上限见适用范围。
entries.assertion: 安全评估：SCCS 认为二氧化钛皮肤涂抹类最高 25% 安全（发用气雾喷雾最高 1.4%；SCCS/1617/20）

entries.title: Zinc oxide (nano form)
entries.scope: 防晒 UV 过滤剂最高 25%（纳米与非纳米）；喷雾产品不能认为安全
entries.excerpt: The SCCS considers that the use of larger (non-nano) forms of ZnO as a UV-filter with a concentration up to 25%, as stated in the SCCP clarification (SCCP/1215/09), is safe and is not of any additional safety concern compared to the nano-forms assessed in this Opinion.
entries.note: 纳米与非纳米氧化锌最高 25% 安全；喷雾产品因吸入风险不能认为安全（SCCS/1518/13 进一步明确）。SCCS 安全评估上限，非功效起效浓度。
entries.assertion: 安全评估：SCCS 认为氧化锌最高 25% 安全（喷雾产品不能认为安全；SCCS/1489/12）

entries.title: Revision of the opinion on 2,2'-Methylene-bis-(6-(2H-benzotriazol-2-yl)-4-(1,1,3,3-tetramethylbutyl)phenol) (nano form)
entries.scope: UV 过滤剂最高 10%；不适用于可吸入暴露产品
entries.excerpt: The SCCNFP is of the opinion that Methylene bis-benzotriazolyl tetramethylbutylphenol is safe for use in cosmetic products as a UV light absorber at a maximum concentration of 10% (SCCNFP/0080/98). SCCS/1546/15: This Opinion therefore does not apply to such applications that might lead to exposure of the consumer's lungs to MBBT nanoparticles by inhalation.
entries.note: 最高 10% 安全（含纳米形式修订意见 SCCS/1546/15）；不适用于可能导致吸入暴露的产品（如喷雾）。SCCS 安全评估上限，非功效起效浓度。
entries.assertion: 安全评估：SCCS 认为亚甲基双-苯并三唑基四甲基丁基酚最高 10% 安全（不适用于可吸入产品；SCCS/1546/15）

entries.title: Scientific advice on the safety of Diethylamino Hydroxybenzoyl Hexyl Benzoate (DHHB, S83)
entries.scope: 最高 10%，杂质邻苯二甲酸二正己酯（DnHexP）≤260ppm（目标 1ppm）
entries.excerpt: The SCCS calculated a maximum safe level of 0.026% (260 ppm) for this impurity in the UV filter DHHB. This applies when DHHB is used up to 10% in cosmetic products and only if DnHexP is an unavoidable impurity. Considering the existence of such alternative manufacturing process for DHHB, the SCCS is of the opinion that a trace level of 1 ppm should be the target for the maximal level of DnHexP as an impurity in DHHB.
entries.note: 此为科学建议（scientific advice），针对杂质 DnHexP：DHHB 最高 10% 使用时 DnHexP ≤260ppm，目标 1ppm。SCCS 安全评估上限，非功效起效浓度。
entries.assertion: 安全评估：SCCS 科学建议认为二乙氨羟苯甲酰基苯甲酸己酯最高 10% 安全（杂质 DnHexP 目标 ≤1ppm；SCCS/1678/25）

entries.title: Butylparaben
entries.scope: 防腐剂最高 0.14%（以酸计）；儿童暴露另有疑虑
entries.excerpt: On the basis of safety assessment considering all available data and the concerns related to endocrine activity, the SCCS is of the opinion that the use of Butylparaben as a preservative in cosmetic products at concentrations of up to 0.14% (expressed as acid) is safe.
entries.note: SCCS/1651/23 结论 0.14% 安全；但 SCCS/1674/25（儿童暴露）认为 0.14% 对各年龄段儿童合计暴露不安全，需按产品类型降低浓度。SCCS 安全评估上限，非功效起效浓度。
entries.assertion: 安全评估：SCCS 认为羟苯丁酯作防腐剂最高 0.14% 安全（儿童合计暴露不安全；SCCS/1651/23、SCCS/1674/25）

entries.title: Propylparaben
entries.scope: 防腐剂最高 0.14%
entries.excerpt: On the basis of the safety assessment of Propylparaben, and considering the concerns related to potential endocrine disrupting properties, the SCCS has concluded that propylparaben is safe when used as a preservative in cosmetic products up to a maximum concentration of 0.14%.
entries.note: SCCS 安全评估上限（0.14%），非功效起效浓度；评估考虑了潜在内分泌干扰疑虑。
entries.assertion: 安全评估：SCCS 认为羟苯丙酯作防腐剂最高 0.14% 安全（SCCS/1623/20）

entries.title: Methylparaben
entries.scope: 防腐剂最高 0.4%（以酸计）；混合酯总量 0.8%（以酸计）
entries.excerpt: On the basis of the safety assessment considering all available data and the concerns related to endocrine activity, the SCCS is of the opinion that the use of Methylparaben as a preservative in cosmetic products at concentrations of up to 0.4% (expressed as acid) is safe.
entries.note: 单用 0.4%（以酸计）安全；与其他羟苯酯混合时总量不超过 0.8%。SCCS 安全评估上限，非功效起效浓度。
entries.assertion: 安全评估：SCCS 认为羟苯甲酯作防腐剂最高 0.4% 安全（混合酯总量 0.8%；SCCS/1652/23）

entries.title: Safety of Triclocarban and Triclosan as substances with potential endocrine disrupting properties
entries.scope: 防腐剂（身体乳除外）与牙膏最高 0.3%；漱口水 0.2%（成人单独使用）
entries.excerpt: The use of Triclosan as a preservative at the concentrations reported in entry 25 of Annex V in dermally applied cosmetic product is safe except for body lotions, when used individually or in combination, for both adults and children (0.5-18 years). The use of Triclosan as a preservative in toothpaste is safe at the concentration of 0.3% when used individually.
entries.note: 皮肤涂抹类（身体乳除外）与牙膏 0.3% 安全；漱口水 0.2% 仅成人单独使用安全，3 岁以下儿童组合使用牙膏不安全。SCCS 安全评估上限，非功效起效浓度。sccs_limit 取该意见内最严上限，分场景上限见适用范围。
entries.assertion: 安全评估：SCCS 认为三氯生作防腐剂最高 0.3% 安全（身体乳除外；SCCS/1643/22）

entries.title: Methylisothiazolinone (MI) - Submission III (Sensitisation only)
entries.scope: 淋洗类产品最高 15ppm（0.0015%）；驻留类未证明安全浓度
entries.excerpt: For leave-on cosmetic products (including 'wet wipes'), no safe concentrations of MI for induction of contact allergy or elicitation have been adequately demonstrated. For rinse-off cosmetic products, a concentration of 15 ppm (0.0015%) MI is considered safe for the consumer from the view of induction of contact allergy.
entries.note: 仅就致敏终点评估：淋洗类 15ppm 安全，驻留类（含湿巾）未能证明安全浓度。SCCS 安全评估上限，非功效起效浓度。
entries.assertion: 安全评估：SCCS 认为甲基异噻唑啉酮淋洗类最高 0.0015% 安全（驻留类未证明安全浓度；SCCS/1557/15）

entries.title: Salicylic acid
entries.scope: 非防腐用途：淋洗类发用 3.0%、其他产品 2.0%（身体乳/眼影/睫毛膏/眼线/唇膏/口服产品/非喷雾除臭剂 0.5%）；防腐剂 0.5%
entries.excerpt: The SCCS is of the opinion that salicylic acid (CAS 69-72-7) is safe when used as preservative at a concentration of 0.5% in cosmetic products, considering its current restrictions in place. The use of salicylic acid as a restricted ingredient for purposes other than inhibiting the development of micro-organisms is safe at a concentration: up to 3.0% for the cosmetic rinse-off hair products, up to 2.0% for other products, except body lotion, eye shadow, mascara, eyeliner, lipstick, non-spray deodorant and oral products.
entries.note: 分场景上限见 scope。SCCS/1675/25（儿童暴露）认为 3-10 岁儿童合计暴露下现有浓度不安全（如皮肤用降至 0.1% 则安全）。SCCS 安全评估上限，非功效起效浓度。sccs_limit 取该意见内最严上限，分场景上限见适用范围。
entries.assertion: 安全评估：SCCS 认为水杨酸一般产品最高 2.0% 安全（淋洗发用 3.0%、防腐 0.5%；儿童暴露不安全；SCCS/1646/22）

entries.title: Revision of the scientific Opinion (SCCS/1576/16) on Vitamin A (Retinol, Retinyl Acetate, Retinyl Palmitate)
entries.scope: 身体乳 0.05% 视黄醇当量（RE）；其他驻留与淋洗产品 0.3% RE
entries.excerpt: The SCCS is of the opinion that vitamin A in cosmetics at the concentrations of 0.05% Retinol Equivalent (RE) in body lotion, and 0.3% RE for other leave-on and rinse-off products is safe.
entries.note: 以视黄醇当量计；覆盖视黄醇、视黄醇乙酸酯、视黄醇棕榈酸酯。SCCS 安全评估上限，非功效起效浓度。sccs_limit 取该意见内最严上限，分场景上限见适用范围。
entries.assertion: 安全评估：SCCS 认为视黄醇最高 0.3% RE（身体乳 0.05% RE）安全（SCCS/1639/21）

entries.title: Revision of the scientific Opinion (SCCS/1576/16) on Vitamin A (Retinol, Retinyl Acetate, Retinyl Palmitate)
entries.scope: 身体乳 0.05% 视黄醇当量（RE）；其他驻留与淋洗产品 0.3% RE
entries.excerpt: The SCCS is of the opinion that vitamin A in cosmetics at the concentrations of 0.05% Retinol Equivalent (RE) in body lotion, and 0.3% RE for other leave-on and rinse-off products is safe.
entries.note: 以视黄醇当量计；覆盖视黄醇、视黄醇乙酸酯、视黄醇棕榈酸酯。SCCS 安全评估上限，非功效起效浓度。sccs_limit 取该意见内最严上限，分场景上限见适用范围。
entries.assertion: 安全评估：SCCS 认为视黄醇乙酸酯最高 0.3% RE（身体乳 0.05% RE）安全（SCCS/1639/21）

entries.title: Revision of the scientific Opinion (SCCS/1576/16) on Vitamin A (Retinol, Retinyl Acetate, Retinyl Palmitate)
entries.scope: 身体乳 0.05% 视黄醇当量（RE）；其他驻留与淋洗产品 0.3% RE
entries.excerpt: The SCCS is of the opinion that vitamin A in cosmetics at the concentrations of 0.05% Retinol Equivalent (RE) in body lotion, and 0.3% RE for other leave-on and rinse-off products is safe.
entries.note: 以视黄醇当量计；覆盖视黄醇、视黄醇乙酸酯、视黄醇棕榈酸酯。SCCS 安全评估上限，非功效起效浓度。sccs_limit 取该意见内最严上限，分场景上限见适用范围。
entries.assertion: 安全评估：SCCS 认为视黄醇棕榈酸酯最高 0.3% RE（身体乳 0.05% RE）安全（SCCS/1639/21）

entries.title: Citral - sensitisation endpoint
entries.scope: 按 QRA2 方法推导的各产品类型致敏上限（无单一数值）
entries.excerpt: The SCCS has noted that the QRA2 methodology has indicated that Citral can be considered safe in relation to the induction of sensitisation at the concentrations proposed for use in cosmetic products.
entries.note: 仅就致敏终点评估：按 QRA2 方法在申报浓度下可认为安全；意见按产品类型给出上限（Table），无单一数值，故不回填 sccs_limit。
entries.assertion: 安全评估：SCCS 认为柠檬醛在 QRA2 推导的致敏上限内使用安全（SCCS/1666/24）

entries.title: The safety of Butylphenyl methylpropional (p-BMHCA) in cosmetic products - Submission II
entries.scope: 香精用途（驻留与淋洗）
entries.excerpt: However, considering the first-tier deterministic aggregate exposure, arising from the use of different product types together, Butylphenyl methylpropional at the proposed concentrations cannot be considered as safe.
entries.note: SCCS 认为按申报浓度（IFRA 限量）合计暴露下不能认为安全；欧盟随后将其列入禁用（ Annex II 1657 项，2022-03-01 起）。
entries.assertion: 安全评估：SCCS 认为丁苯基甲基丙醛（铃兰醛）在申报浓度下不安全（SCCS/1591/17）

entries.title: Hydroxyisohexyl 3-cyclohexene carboxaldehyde (HICC)
entries.scope: 香精用途
entries.excerpt: HICC is not considered safe even at concentrations as low as 200 ppm. Therefore, HICC should not be used in consumer products in order to prevent further cases of contact allergy to HICC and to limit the consequences to those who already have become sensitized.
entries.note: SCCS 认为即使低至 200ppm 也不安全，不应在消费品中使用；欧盟随后禁用（2017 年修订，2021-08-23 起停售）。
entries.assertion: 安全评估：SCCS 认为羟异己基 3-环己烯基甲醛（HICC）不应使用（200ppm 亦不安全；SCCS/1456/11）

entries.title: Benzyl salicylate
entries.scope: 按意见 Table 1 各产品类型上限（无单一数值）
entries.excerpt: Based on the assessment of data provided and taking under consideration the concerns related to potential endocrine disrupting properties, the SCCS considers Benzyl Salicylate safe when used up to the maximum concentrations as provided in Table 1 of this Opinion.
entries.note: 按意见 Table 1 分产品类型上限安全；无单一数值，故不回填 sccs_limit；评估考虑了潜在内分泌干扰疑虑。
entries.assertion: 安全评估：SCCS 认为水杨酸苄酯在意见 Table 1 各品类上限内使用安全（SCCS/1656/23）

entries.title: Toluene-2,5-diamine and its sulfate (COLIPA n°A5)
entries.scope: 氧化型染发剂上头浓度最高 2.0%（以游离基计）
entries.excerpt: The applied concentration on-head of maximum 2% (calculated as free base) or 3.6% (calculated as sulfate salt) is considered to be safe with regard to systemic toxicity (toxicokinetics based MoS >25). Toluene-2,5-diamine is an extreme skin sensitiser.
entries.note: 上头浓度 2.0%（游离基计）系统毒性可接受；甲苯-2,5-二胺为极端皮肤致敏物。SCCS 安全评估上限，非功效起效浓度。
entries.assertion: 安全评估：SCCS 认为甲苯-2,5-二胺染发上头浓度最高 2.0% 安全（极端致敏物；SCCS/1479/12）

entries.title: p-Phenylenediamine (COLIPA n°A7)
entries.scope: 氧化型染发剂上头浓度最高 2.0%
entries.excerpt: In view of the intermittent exposure and the fact that human exposure through hair dyeing is mainly to N,N'-diacetyl PPD (a non-mutagenic detoxified metabolite), no concern regarding systemic toxicity is raised, when PPD is used in oxidative hair colouring products at on-head concentrations of up to 2.0%.
entries.note: 上头浓度 2.0% 系统毒性无虞；对苯二胺为极强接触致敏物，是消费者常见过敏原。SCCS 安全评估上限，非功效起效浓度。
entries.assertion: 安全评估：SCCS 认为对苯二胺染发上头浓度最高 2.0% 安全（极强致敏物；SCCS/1443/11）

entries.title: Resorcinol
entries.scope: 护发乳与洗发水最高 0.5%；氧化型染发剂（发用与睫毛）最高 1.25%
entries.excerpt: Keeping in view the evidence on endocrine disrupting properties of resorcinol, the SCCS assessment shows that resorcinol is safe when used as an oxidative hair dye in products intended for hair and eyelashes up to 1.25 % and up to 0.5 % in hair lotions and shampoos.
entries.note: 与既有 legal_cap 0.5%（《规范2015》表3 发露和香波）一致，不冲突；氧化型染发 1.25%。SCCS 安全评估上限，非功效起效浓度。
entries.assertion: 安全评估：SCCS 认为间苯二酚护发乳/洗发水最高 0.5%、氧化型染发最高 1.25% 安全（SCCS/1619/20）

entries.title: Phenoxyethanol
entries.scope: 防腐剂最高 1.0%（全年龄段含儿童）
entries.excerpt: The SCCS considers 2-phenoxyethanol safe for use as a preservative with a maximum concentration of 1.0%, taking into account the information provided.
entries.note: 与既有 legal_cap 1.0%（《规范2015》表4 准用防腐剂）一致，不冲突。SCCS 安全评估上限，非功效起效浓度。
entries.assertion: 安全评估：SCCS 认为苯氧乙醇作防腐剂最高 1.0% 安全（SCCS/1575/16）

entries.title: Butylated Hydroxytoluene (BHT)
entries.scope: 其他驻留与淋洗产品最高 0.8%；牙膏 0.1%；漱口水 0.001%
entries.excerpt: On the basis of a safety assessment, and considering the concerns related to potential endocrine disrupting properties of BHT, the SCCS is of the opinion that BHT is safe as an ingredient up to a maximum concentration of 0.001% in mouthwash and 0.1% in toothpaste. ... BHT is safe as an ingredient up to a maximum concentration of 0.8% in other leave-on and rinse-off products.
entries.note: SCCS 安全评估上限（一般产品 0.8%），非功效起效浓度。sccs_limit 取该意见内最严上限，分场景上限见适用范围。
entries.assertion: 安全评估：SCCS 认为丁羟甲苯最高 0.8% 安全（牙膏 0.1%、漱口水 0.001%；SCCS/1636/21）

entries.title: Dihydroxyacetone (DHA)
entries.scope: 美黑乳液与面霜最高 10%；非氧化染发驻留最高 6.25%
entries.excerpt: On the basis of data provided, the SCCS considers Dihydroxyacetone safe when used as hair colouring ingredient in leave-on applications (non-oxidative) up to a maximum concentration of 6.25%. The use ... together with the use of self-tanning lotion and face cream containing up to a maximum concentration of 10% Dihydroxyacetone is considered safe.
entries.note: 美黑用途 10% 与非氧化染发 6.25% 组合使用亦安全。SCCS 安全评估上限，非功效起效浓度。sccs_limit 取该意见内最严上限，分场景上限见适用范围。
entries.assertion: 安全评估：SCCS 认为二羟丙酮美黑产品最高 10% 安全（非氧化染发 6.25%；SCCS/1612/19）

entries.title: Zinc Pyrithione (ZPT) - Submission III
entries.scope: 去屑淋洗类发用产品最高 1%
entries.excerpt: The SCCS considers Zinc Pyrithione (ZPT) as safe when used as an anti-dandruff in rinse-off hair products up to a maximum concentration of 1%.
entries.note: 该结论基于 CMR 豁免条款（Regulation 1223/2009 第 15(d) 条）；欧盟 2022-03-01 起已禁用 ZPT（SCCS/1593/20 认为无替代豁免不成立）。SCCS 安全评估上限，非功效起效浓度。
entries.assertion: 安全评估：SCCS 认为吡硫鎓锌去屑淋洗发用最高 1% 安全（SCCS/1614/19；欧盟 2022 年起已禁用）
